seo.title: Experience
seo.description: Work experience of Mohd Ansar Bux: software engineer at Apex Structure and software engineer & team lead at Jaitrrrm.

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.summary: I own the company's full web platform — main website, backend and admin CMS — from design to deployment.
responsibilities: Built the full web platform (main website, backend and admin CMS) with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express.js and MySQL, and handle it from design to maintenance.
Set up and manage AWS infrastructure (EC2, RDS, S3, CloudFront, SES, Route 53, CloudWatch) and built CI/CD pipelines.
Developed and secured REST APIs with JWT, CSRF protection and role-based access for super admins and HR users.
Built the CMS dashboard in React.js with TanStack Query to manage all site data in real time.
achievements: Deployment time cut by about 40%, to around 15 minutes per release

roles.title: Software Engineer & Team Leader
roles.summary: Led 8+ engineers to deliver Alpha-Way v1, a B2B SaaS platform, and built its Spring Boot backend.
responsibilities: Led a team of 8+ engineers: sprint planning, task assignment and code reviews in an Agile setup.
Designed and built a layered Java Spring Boot backend with 50+ REST APIs for the client dashboard and admin modules.
Documented APIs in Postman and managed code with Git and GitHub.
Implemented JWT authentication and role-based access for admin and operator users, and defined API contracts with the Next.js/TypeScript frontend team.

roles.title: Java Full Stack Trainee
roles.summary: Industry-grade Java full-stack programme, completed with Grade A (79%).
responsibilities: Covered Java, Spring Boot, RESTful API design and frontend integration workflows.

roles.title: Java Full Stack Intern
roles.summary: Structured Java full-stack training through batch-based practical projects.
responsibilities: Covered core Java, OOP principles, backend development and web application fundamentals.
